S41.01.note: The + menu button has no visible text found in the code, and the Settings default applies to new chats only.
steps: Sign in and open a new chat.
Click the + button under the message box and click Temporary chat.
Look for the Temporary chat banner in the top bar and the line Stays out of your history, search, memory and Library.
Compare with Expected: a temporary chat can be started from the chat surface.
S41.01.where: The + button under the message box > Temporary chat. Or Settings > Privacy > Start new chats as temporary (sets the default for new chats).

S41.02.note: The banner is hidden on small screens for the explanation text only (CSS hidden sm:inline), the label stays.
steps: Start a temporary chat as in S41.01.
Send a message and wait for the reply.
Check that the label Temporary chat stays in the top bar while the chat is open, with the Personalized or Unpersonalized switch beside it.
Compare with Expected: the banner stays visible for as long as the chat is open.
S41.02.where: Start a chat with the + button > Temporary chat. The label Temporary chat sits in the top bar of the chat, and hovering it shows the retention note.

S41.03.needs: a signed-in account; a second search after the chat is finished
S41.03.note: The code says temporary chats are left out of search, but the earlier check reported the completed chat appearing in global search, so the expected behaviour may not match.
steps: Start a temporary chat and hover the Temporary chat label in the top bar.
Read the text shown: Won't be saved to your history and skips memory for this turn.
Open Settings > Privacy and expand How we protect your data.
Send a temporary chat, then search the history for a word from it and compare with Expected.
S41.03.where: Chat top bar: hover the Temporary chat label. Also Settings > Privacy > How we protect your data.

labels.text: Temporary chats never read or save memory.

S41.04.needs: a signed-in account with Memory on
S41.04.note: The code disables the + menu Memory row in a temporary chat (memoryDisabled when isIncognito) and says memory is never read, so no choice is offered; I searched ChatComposerNew.tsx for memory handling and found no per-chat read choice.

labels.text: Won't be saved to your history and skips memory for this turn.

S41.05.needs: a signed-in account with Memory on
S41.05.note: A tester cannot see the memory store directly from the UI in the code I read, so this can only be compared through the note.
steps: Start a temporary chat and hover the Temporary chat label.
Read the text Won't be saved to your history and skips memory for this turn.
Compare with Expected: nothing from the temporary chat should appear in memory.
S41.05.where: No control; the effect is that the memory of a temporary turn is skipped, shown only by the note on the temporary chat.

S41.06.needs: a signed-in account with custom instructions set
steps: Start a temporary chat.
Look at the switch in the top bar, which reads Personalized by default.
Click it and read the title hint: Personalized uses your profile, instructions and response style.
Send a message and compare the reply with Expected: custom instructions apply only when Personalized is on.
S41.06.where: Chat top bar > Personalized / Unpersonalized switch, shown only in a temporary chat.

labels.text: Won't be saved to your history or show up in search, and skips memory.

S41.07.needs: a signed-in account; a connector connected
S41.07.note: The connector wording is in the retention note under the Temporary chat row, not next to Plugins itself.
steps: Start a temporary chat.
Click the + button under the message box and open Plugins.
Read the note under the Temporary chat row: Won't be saved to your history or show up in search, and skips memory.
Compare with Expected: the note should say how a connector behaves in a temporary chat, such as asking before each call.
S41.07.where: The + button under the message box > Plugins, while a temporary chat is open.

labels.text: Kept out of your Library and deleted with this temporary chat.

S41.08.needs: a file to upload; a signed-in account
S41.08.note: The attach row's exact visible label was not located; the note is shown on that row.
steps: Start a temporary chat and click the + button.
Hover or read the attach row note: Kept out of your Library and deleted with this temporary chat.
Open Settings > Privacy > How we protect your data and read: A temporary chat and its attachments are removed after 30 days.
Compare with Expected: the note should match what happens to an attached file.
S41.08.where: The + button under the message box > the file attach row while a temporary chat is open. Also Settings > Privacy > How we protect your data.

S41.09.needs: a signed-in account and an image or video generated in a temporary chat
S41.09.note: I searched apps/web/lib/server/media-assets.ts and apps/web/app/api/media/video/generate/route.ts; they set a temporary_chat flag but I found no visible keep or save control for generated output.

S41.10.note: The dialog appears only when the chat has messages to keep; an empty chat changes without a dialog.
steps: Open a temporary chat with a few messages.
Click the + button and click Temporary chat to turn it off.
In the dialog Save this chat?, click Save chat.
Open the chat from the sidebar history and check the messages are there, and compare with Expected: everything is kept.
S41.10.where: The + button under the message box > Temporary chat (switch it off) > Save chat in the dialog.

S41.11.note: This dialog and the one for S41.10 are the same dialog; it states the count of messages and says the chat then follows memory and data settings.
steps: Open a temporary chat with messages.
Click the + button and click Temporary chat to turn it off.
Read the dialog text: the number of messages, and any files, will be kept in your history.
Click Save chat, or close the dialog to cancel, and compare with Expected: the user sees what is kept before confirming.
S41.11.where: The + button under the message box > Temporary chat (switch it off), then read the dialog Save this chat?.

labels.text: Only use models that do not train on your chats

S41.18.note: The earlier check marked the privacy controls as UI-only, and the retention text is inside expandable sections.
steps: Open Settings > Privacy.
Find the switch Start new chats as temporary and read its line: Not saved to history or search, and deleted after 30 days.
Expand How we protect your data and How we use your data.
Compare with Expected: history, model training and retention each have a separate control or statement.
S41.18.where: Settings > Privacy (Start new chats as temporary, How we protect your data, How we use your data, and the Only use models that do not train on your chats switch).

labels.text: Not saved to history or search, and deleted after 30 days. Project chats are saved.

S41.19.note: The explanation for each setting is in the Privacy page, not on the chat surface.
steps: Open Settings > Privacy.
Read the grey line under Start new chats as temporary: Not saved to history or search, and deleted after 30 days. Project chats are saved.
Read the grey line under Privacy requests and expand How we protect your data.
Compare with Expected: each setting explains what it does in place.
S41.19.where: Settings > Privacy: the short line under each switch, such as Start new chats as temporary, and the expandable sections.

labels.text: Where each feature processes your data
Cloud, then the AI provider that serves the model you chose.

steps: Open Settings > Privacy.
Expand Where each feature processes your data.
Read the rows, for example Chat: Cloud, then the AI provider that serves the model you chose.
Compare with Expected: each feature names where its data is processed.
S41.20.where: Settings > Privacy > Where each feature processes your data.
